BrochureContent.Content: A substantial three storey period house offering spacious accommodation of c. 260 sq. m and situated in sought after Drumcondra, minutes from the train station, shops, restaurants and colleges, the Mater and Temple Street hospitals along with a host of other valuable local amenities. Currently laid out in 8 x Pre'63 apartments ( 5 x 1 beds, 2 x studio,  & 1 x 2 bed) and offering an excellent opportunity to generate substantial monthly income.  The property retains most of its original features, including high ceilings with ornate cornices, original staircase and window casings. To the rear is a generous sized garden to rear with vehicular access to a storge shed. A superb choice for an investor seeking a substantial property in this established rental location. Vacant possession will be available to the new owner.
